snippet.title: Teeko | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Teeko
Hop on the perfect mix of platforming and tower defense as Teeko, a cute sloth. Jump, smash, and plant trees to defeat the rampaging gigante masks of Costa Rica’s Día de las Mascaradas festival and their hordes of enemies.
